summary: Steep, narrow residential street with houses 10-20 m away along the whole stretch.
reasons: No Parking Any Time signs both ends

drivers.seclusion: Homes line both sides, 10-24 m from the kerb all along; nowhere is clear of dwellings.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane with kerb-to-fence verges; little room to pull fully off.
drivers.convention: Two No Parking Any Time signs about 11 m off the line; a few cars park on the street but not as a camping convention.

flags: No Parking Any Time signs on Eldon Street
Mapped gate 72 m away has a way round it (not on only access)
sun_shade: Mixed street trees shade the road, mostly from the west side.
